as_built.behavior: Exec.RunA calls the compiled Walk1 without a catch. A run-time error (a generator defect, or a class deleted outside DropAll while its entry stays 'ok') leaves Run. The engine answers the read on the SQL path with one warning per reason per engine, and the entry stays 'ok', so each later read of that shape fails natively first. Not run live: exercising it needs a compiled IVGC class, which lane rules forbid (Gen mode is off in every probe).

intended.reading: ADR-0014's invariant (a compiled class answers as the interpreter) and spec 257 FR-004 (the interpreter is the fallback) point to the interpreter answering a shape whose compiled class fails, with the entry set aside like a failed build. The ADR's enumerated cases omit run-time failure, and FR-004 is draft.

entries.working_assumption: Treat a run-time failure of a compiled entry as a fallback outcome: quarantine the entry for that plan generation (as a failed build already is), let the interpreter answer, and retry only after invalidation (a new stamp, DropAll or a deploy). SQL fallback for every later read (as built) is a correct-answer but degraded baseline that violates ADR-0014's 'answers exactly as the interpreter'.

changed_from_decisions_md.why: Refined. decisions.md said 'a fallback outcome' without naming one. ADR-0014's invariant and spec 257 FR-004 name the interpreter as the fallback, and Gen's 'a failed build is not tried again' rule is the existing quarantine precedent.

(b) catch errors from Walk1 in RunA, mark the entry failed and re-run the walk interpreted
(c) mark the entry failed but let SQL answer this read
entries.what_would_change: A maintainer statement that SQL fallback is the intended recovery for compiled failures, or an amendment of ADR-0014's invariant to exclude run-time faults.

discriminating_check.ref: Minimal model. State: entry(s) in {absent, pending, ok, failed}; class(s) in {present-good, present-faulty, absent}. Actions: Read(s), BuildOk, BuildFail, ExternalDelete(class), DropAll/Deploy (clear both). Property Q1 (ADR-0014): every Read(s) is answered by native (compiled or interpreter) whenever the interpreter would answer. Q2: after the first run-time fault of s, no later Read(s) invokes the faulty class until invalidation. As-built trace Read(ok, absent class) -> raise -> SQL, repeated, violates Q1 and Q2; (b) satisfies both; (c) satisfies Q2 only.
